title: The second free letter
note: The second letter is kept like the first. "That was your second free letter." shows once, as the Book's toast after the landing, with no count of what is left (D-082, S21).
text: Asha's book Read together This month The first weeks 2 letters · From Mama October 31 to November 29 Saturday, October 31, 2026 You laughed at the rain. From Mama Saturday, October 31, 2026 You held the spoon by yourself today. From Mama Tonight Book Family That was your second free letter.
lines: You held the spoon by yourself today.
That was your second free letter.
